August 14, 1970 
For release at will 


THE FUTURE? 
WELCOME TO THE LAURENTIAN DESERT 
VISITORS ARE WARNED 
1. Do not drink any water 
2. Do not remove respirator 
3. Leave no skin exposed 
4. Keep food pills closed 
5. Do not remove ear plugs 
6. Do not remove coveralls 

Think it can't happen? It's happening right now in the 
lobby of the Downtown Branch of the Montreal YMCA, where a huge 
display on pollution warns about commonly used household articles 
such as Bio-Ad, Raid, metal paper, empty soft drink cans, etc. 

Articles will be changed regularly and the "Pollutant of 
the Week” will be exhibited. 

The display sets guidelines for concerned citizens who wish 
to join in the fight against pollution and warns of what will 
happen if proper steps are not taken now. 

"Tp, initially, we are only able to combat these problems 
through educational means, we will be making an important and 
positive contribution to what is fast becoming mankind's greatest 
threat to survival,” says V. Hryhorchuk, Executive Secretary of 


the Downtown Branch.
